intel.pattern: Garry froze a five-verb memory protocol (the way Postgres speaks one wire protocol to every client). Any MCP harness points at gbrain serve --surface verbs and sees exactly five self-describing tools. Contract is additive-forever: v1 field names and meanings never change. 23/23 CONFORMANT tests. This is the pattern for N-079 (Agent Knowledge Transfer Architecture): freeze the contract, let implementations conform.

intel.title: Multi-Agent Research System — Orchestrator-Worker, Subagent File Output, Context Management
intel.pattern: Three patterns: (1) Subagent output to filesystem to avoid 'game of telephone' — bypass coordinator for structured outputs, pass lightweight references. (2) Long-horizon context management — agents summarize completed phases, store to external memory, spawn fresh subagents with clean contexts. (3) Prompt engineering for delegation — teach the orchestrator to give subagents clear objectives, output formats, tool guidance, and task boundaries.
intel.applies_to: Agent Knowledge Transfer (N-079), product operating model, cross-agent coordination
